# Bluesky (4 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /profile | `handle` | 1 | Get a Bluesky profile |
| /user/posts | `handle` / `user_id` | 1 | List a Bluesky user's posts |
| /post | `url` | 1 | Get a Bluesky post |
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search Bluesky posts |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /profile — 1cr

Returns a Bluesky user's public profile: handle, displayName, avatar, description, followersCount, followsCount, postsCount, createdAt, and verification status.

**Parameters**

- `handle`: Bluesky handle (e.g. `espn.com`).

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/profile?handle=<handle>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /user/posts — 1cr

Returns a feed of posts for a Bluesky user: uri, record text, author info, embeds, replyCount, repostCount, likeCount, quoteCount, and indexedAt. Pass either `handle` or `user_id` (Bluesky calls user IDs `did`).

**Parameters**

- `handle` / `user_id` — at least one required.
  - `handle`: Bluesky handle. (one of: handle, user_id; at least one required)
  - `user_id`: Bluesky `did` (Bluesky's internal user ID format, e.g. `did:plc:x7d6j54pm22ufehkes6jo4jf`). (one of: handle, user_id; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/user/posts?handle=<handle>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /post — 1cr

Returns a single Bluesky post: record text, author info, embeds, replyCount, repostCount, likeCount, quoteCount, and a threaded `replies` array.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Bluesky post URL.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/post?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search — 1cr

Searches public Bluesky posts by keyword and returns up to 100 posts in one page, in the unified Post shape under `data.items[]`: each item is `{ post: { id, url, content, author, engagement, flags, published_at } }`. `post.id` is the post's record key, `post.url` is its bsky.app permalink, `engagement.likes` / `comments` / `shares` are the like, reply and repost counts, and `published_at` is when the author wrote it. Newest first by default; `sort=top` uses Bluesky's top ranking instead. Narrow with `since` / `until`, `lang` and `author`. There is no cursor: to reach older posts with the default `sort=latest`, call again with `until` set to the oldest `published_at` you received. A query that matches nothing returns an empty `items` list.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search terms matched against post text.
- `sort` *(optional)*: `latest` (newest first, the default) or `top` (Bluesky's own top ranking, which favours popular posts over recent ones).
- `since` *(optional)*: Only posts written at or after this time. ISO 8601 date (`2026-09-01`) or datetime with a timezone (`2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`); any other shape is rejected with a free 400.
- `until` *(optional)*: Only posts written before this time. Same format as `since`. Set it to the oldest `published_at` of your last call to fetch the next older batch; the boundary is compared to the second, so a post from that same second can repeat, and deduplicating on `post.id` removes it.
- `lang` *(optional)*: Only posts tagged with this language, as a code such as `en`, `ja` or `ko`.
- `author` *(optional)*: Only posts by this account: a handle such as `espn.com` or a `did` such as `did:plc:...`. An account that does not exist returns an empty list.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/bluesky/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Bluesky endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| A profile | `/profile` | 1 |
| That user's posts | `/user/posts` | 1 |
| One post's detail | `/post` | 1 |

All 1 credit. There is **no search endpoint** here — you must already know the handle. To
discover who to look at, find them elsewhere (`twitter/profile`, `threads/search/users`) and
carry the handle over; many accounts reuse the same handle across networks.

`prism/voice` (5cr) merges one person's public posts across X, Threads, Bluesky and Truth
Social into a single time-ordered feed — cheaper and cleaner than three separate pulls when
you want someone's whole posting voice rather than one network's slice.
